title: Approval button
responsibility: Saves approval of the latest displayed plan or design with its exact contract and selected images.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.entity
inputs.description: Entity providing category, identifier, latest version and contract hash. Approval requires a hash; pages, shells and components also require selected images. Functions use Plan wording.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace providing writability, approval bridge and project context. Missing or nonwritable snapshot blocks approval. Refreshes the workspace after saving the decision.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.design
inputs.description: Version to approve; must equal the entity’s latest version. Its selected image hashes are sent with the approval. Versions with options also send the selected option identifier.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.approved
inputs.description: True disables approval and shows the approved-version label.

inputs.name: ApprovalButton.option
inputs.description: Optional selected option identifier, empty by default. Determines the images whose hashes are approved and is included when the design has options.

outputs.name: ApprovalButton
outputs.description: Approval button disabled for existing approval, an older version, missing contract hash or required images, a nonwritable workspace or an in-progress approval. Catches save/refresh failures as alerts and clears busy state afterward. Explains that approval saves a decision and only a Change request starts code work.
